assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's condition.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10.
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation.
Unspecified atrial fibrillation is coded I48.91.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes.
Such arrhythmic or ischemic changes may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The provider requests reconsideration of the CO-197 determination (appeal rights exist).
